einzeiler: Interviews with sports figures and journalists covering college football and the NBA.
kurzfassung: The episode features conversations with Michigan football coach Kyle Whittingham, former NFL linebacker Luke Kuechly, Big Ten Commissioner Tony Petitti, and journalist Pablo Torre. They discuss college football transitions, the realities of playing in the NFL, the state of collegiate sports governance, and the investigation into the Los Angeles Clippers.
stichpunkte: Kyle Whittingham discusses taking over as head coach at Michigan after many years at Utah.
Whittingham addresses the intensity of the rivalry with Ohio State and the unique landscape of modern college football.
Luke Kuechly shares insights on transitioning from the NFL to a broadcasting role with Netflix.
Kuechly reflects on his rookie year welcome-to-the-NFL moment and playing alongside players like Cam Newton.
Big Ten Commissioner Tony Petitti talks about the historic success of Big Ten teams and potential formats for the College Football Playoff.
Petitti discusses the complexities of roster management, postseason access, and scheduling cross-conference matchups.
Journalist Pablo Torre details the extensive investigation into the Los Angeles Clippers and salary cap circumvention involving Kawhi Leonard.
Torre explains the NBA's disciplinary actions against Steve Ballmer and the fallout from competing media reports.

clips.text: The guest compares college athletics unfavorably to professional sports, suggesting that collegiate sports need a structured minor league model with strict enforcement similar to the world's best-run sports organization.
A former NFL player humorously notes that given his size and academic focus during his youth, even he would not have recruited himself out of high school.

clips.hook: Most successful year in Big Ten history
clips.text: The conference commissioner highlights a dominant athletic season featuring multiple national championships across football and basketball.
The sports executive outlines how the conference aims to enhance regular-season matchups and solve postseason access challenges without altering the overall organizational structure.
An investigative journalist breaks down specific corporate entities and multi-million dollar figures linked to off-the-books financial arrangements discovered during an inquiry.

beschreibung:
Dan talks to Michigan HC Kyle Whittingham about their rivalry with Ohio State and the prospect of allowing players to return to college sports after playing in NFL preseason games. Newly inducted Pro Football Hall of Fame LB Luke Kuechly stops by to chop it up with DP. Big Ten commissioner Tony Petetti joins Dan and talks about the growth of the conference and how they navigate the contemporary age of college football, and the possibility of a big SEC-Big Ten challenge as the two conferences continue to stand above everyone else. And investigative reporter Pablo Torre of “Pablo Torre Finds Out” joins Dan to talk about the punishment handed down to the Clippers stemming from his detective work. Torre defends himself and his reporting and explains how the NBA found this evidence.
